note: Pinned AI readers (design v2, section 9). Every model is identified by its file SHA-256; every reading stores reader, version and model hash. A model is swapped only after it passes the admission exam (rules/exam/) and fits the time budget. Training cutoffs are recorded: readings of documents dated before a model's cutoff never count as evidence (rigour charter rule 8).

finbert.role: sentiment of every item (title and lead)
finbert.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial: replace before any commercial step, e.g. with an Apache-licensed financial sentiment encoder)

gliner.role: entity spans of every item, linked by the deterministic dictionary

embed.role: 256-dimension embeddings for retrieval (exact cosine in DuckDB)
embed.license: Gemma Terms of Use (commercial use allowed under the Gemma prohibited-use policy)
embed.exam: exam v1 same-topic 47.5% (test retired for retrieval); exam v2 retrieval 2026-11-19: recall@1 0.925, recall@3 1.0, 0.04 s/item
embed.admitted: exam v2, 2026-11-19 (kept: ties the best candidate and is 10x faster)

llm.role: structured reading of the triaged items (event type, companies affected, direction, magnitude, horizon)
llm.training_cutoff: 2026-04-01 (release date used as a conservative bound; the cutoff is not published)
llm.admitted: exam v1, 2026-11-16: JSON 100%, event type 70.0%, direction 81.2%, ticker F1 0.897, 17.6 s/item

brief.role: Daily World Brief and sector headwind/tailwind scores, from knowledge-base facts and retrieved documents dated <= T
brief.training_cutoff: 2026-03-02 (release date used as a conservative bound; the cutoff is not published)
